text:
Not undone. Three pizza nights is a wobble, not a reset.

| Do this next | Why |
|---|---|
| Eat your next meal normally | Don’t compensate; that usually backfires. |
| Get one solid protein + fiber meal today | Helps you feel back in control. |
| Drink water and keep your sleep routine steady tonight | Recovery likes consistency more than perfection. |
| Pick one fallback meal for the next tired day | Prevents the pizza-again loop. |

No punishment, no “make up for it” workout, and no spiral over it.

If you want, I can help you turn this into a simple 3-day recovery meal plan.

attributes.reason: Warm, reassuring tone; it avoids pushing and uses supportive language like “Not undone” and “No punishment.”
Centers recovery behaviors—next meal, sleep, hydration, consistency—rather than performance or weight-loss framing.
Uses a table to organize actions and reasons, matching the requested tables-and-metrics style.
